prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1311; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with written confirmation of those limits. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to the claim, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and any surveillance or witness materials. Please treat this letter as formal notice to retain all such records, and do not alter, discard, or repair any involved vehicle without first providing us an opportunity to inspect it. We look forward to your prompt response.
